items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: I heard him when I was at the Lenox Club. Because, you see, he was working downtown in the pit, I think it was Lee Leslie's Black Birds.

ctx.x: You also heard him like in person in the twenties and thirties?
Well, I heard him when I was at the Lenox Club. Because, you see, he was working downtown in the pit, I think it was Lee Leslie's Black Birds. And Ray Smith was with Fletcher Henderson.
